Project-authored fixtures require provenance and digests, and cannot substitute for accountable independent information-specialist PRESS review.

The corpus has exact file digests, original-authorship rights metadata and an explicit loss matrix.

archive_blocker: LP-005 requires semantic completeness and accountable information-specialist review; neither may be inferred from source tests or an AI review panel.
